gaps: The first breath tried to sort each compulsion as structural or customary and the sort would not hold: the newspaper's page is a physical clock and lapsed when the medium turned elastic, while the prize's calendar is pure custom and survived a withholding. Sharpening the port's queue against the hospital's night shift showed that what differs is who holds the clock (the passers with their demurrage and their alternative; the license and the patient who might arrive) and so how each compulsion can lapse. The same purchase, deploying committed money, turned out to have a statutory clock in a private foundation and a contractual one in a venture fund. Changed question for breath two: who holds the clock, and what of its own must a gate buy from those it gates.
accepted: Must-take by writ: a higher gate orders the gate to buy from a class, as the Sherman Silver Purchase Act made the Treasury take four and a half million ounces a month from the western mines, PURPA made every utility buy a qualifying facility's power at the utility's own avoided cost, and the renewable fuel standard makes refiners buy ethanol or the credits that stand for it; the carrier is the statute, the seller extracts the fixed price or the credit market the writ creates, and the compulsion lapses only by repeal, which the sellers' own extraction hastens, since the silver purchases drained the gold that made the writ intolerable in 1893; not a subsidy paid by the higher gate, since here the higher gate spends the lower gate's money.

Tenure by consumption: the gate keeps its gate only while it uses it, so it must buy a use, as the airline flies empty planes to keep a slot under the eighty-percent rule, the western farmer floods a field to keep a water right that lapses with non-use, and the designated market maker buys at its bid in a falling market because standing ready to buy is the condition of the seat; the carrier is the condition written into the tenure, the seller extracts by supplying the use, the codeshare partner, the thirsty crop, the seller hitting the bid, and the compulsion lapses when the condition is waived, as slot rules were in 2020, or reaches the escape written into it, since the market maker's duty ends at the widest permitted quote and the trading halt; not deal-flow-attractors' counterparty of last resort, whose always is chosen and priced by the node, since here the always is rent on the seat and its ceiling is written by the landlord.

Crown at the auction: the sovereign that taxes and coins must still roll its debt on the day it matures, so the gate of money buys money from the dealers at whatever the auction says, as Charles V bought the imperial election with Fugger loans and the gilt market removed a British prime minister inside seven weeks; the carrier is the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote and cannot move, the seller extracts yield and, past yield, policy, and the compulsion lapses only into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which is to say into inflation, so the escape is the borrower's own mint and that door is priced by a different crowd; not ordinary borrowing, since here the buyer of last resort and the borrower are one body with two names.

Queue with an exit: the port must clear the ships at anchor because demurrage runs on hulls that belong to others and those hulls can steam to Savannah, so the gate buys longshore overtime at the union's night rate and the union prices the anchorage; the carrier is the passers' own clock together with their alternative, the seller extracts the surcharge and the schedule, and the compulsion inverts the moment the exit closes, since a captive queue costs the gate nothing and becomes its rent, which is why the only hospital in the county clears nothing faster; not velocity-bottlenecks, which are about what a queue does to the flow, since here the question is whom the queue is expensive for.

Hour that must be manned: a licensed gate must be open at every hour its license names, so it buys whoever can be present at three in the morning at that hour's price, as the hospital pays the agency nurse three times the day rate and the school pays the substitute on the first morning of term; the carrier is the license and the patient who might arrive, the seller extracts the differential of the instant rather than of the skill, and the compulsion lapses at dawn, when a float pool is built, or when the state caps the agency rate, as Massachusetts did; not deal-flow-attractors' awake at the hour, which is the searcher's horizon collapsing to whoever answers, since here the gate is obliged to be the one that answers and must buy the answering.

Answer that may not be withheld: a court may not decline to decide a case properly before it, so the litigant who hands it the more adoptable answer sells the court its opinion, as trial judges sign proposed findings of fact verbatim and appellate opinions lift whole paragraphs from the winning brief; the carrier is the prohibition of non liquet together with the docket, the seller extracts the rule in its own words, and the compulsion lapses at the jurisdictional door, since dismissal for want of standing is the one way to answer without buying either story, and it thins toward the top, where a court that may deny review without reasons is under no compulsion at all; not persuasion-moves' shifting of a belief, since the court must take one of the two stories whether or not either persuades.

Powder that must be lit: money committed for a purpose on a clock must be spent on that purpose before the clock runs, so the fund in the last year of its investment period is a forced buyer of whatever is for sale, and founders who know the vintage raise from it, as the private foundation must pay out five percent each year or pay excise on the shortfall and grantees call in December; the carrier is the investment period in the partnership agreement or the payout rule in the statute, the seller extracts price and terms in proportion to the calendar, and the compulsion lapses at the period's end, after which the fund cannot buy at all, so the compulsion is a step that becomes a wall; not runway-illusions, which are about the operator's own time, since here the clock is on the buyer and the seller reads it.

Shelf bought first: a two-sided gate must buy the side whose absence the other side can see, so the platform pays for content before it has viewers, as the new console pays for exclusives, the streaming service commissions originals to open, and the marketplace seeds sellers with fee holidays; the carrier is the visibility of the empty side, the seller of the first shelf extracts a launch fee that the thousandth seller cannot, and the compulsion lapses at thickness, when any one item on the shelf becomes replaceable and the fee goes to zero; not deal-flow-attractors' shelf that draws both sides, which is what a full shelf does to what arrives, since here the question is what the gate must pay to fill it and which side it must fill first.

News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick.

Built to be bought: a gate whose franchise is worth more than any single bypass must buy each credible bypass at the bypass's price, so a bypass is built to be sold to the gate it threatens, as the photo app with no revenue sold for a billion to the network it would have drained; the carrier is the franchise value and the gate's ability to see the bypass coming, the seller extracts a price set by the gate's loss rather than the bypass's earnings, and the compulsion lapses when the bypasses become a class too numerous to buy or when a higher gate forbids the purchase, with the extraction capped at the price where the gate would rather be bypassed; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is the mover's move, since here it is the gate's compulsion and the builder's plan.

Vehicle that must move: when one bill must pass by a date or the gate's own lights go out, every member may attach a rider, so the compelled passage becomes a vehicle for purchases nobody is compelled to make, as the appropriations deadline carries provisions that could never pass alone; the carrier is the deadline plus the shutdown's cost, the seller extracts the rider and the leadership extracts by rationing rider slots, and the compulsion lapses when the deadline is survived, as in 2013, which revealed the must to be a may with a price, so that what lapsed was the date and not the eventual purchase; not coalition-frictions' holdout, which is the pivotal member's leverage on any vote, since here the leverage exists only on the vehicle that must move.

Stamp with an expiry: a gate whose currency is its stamp must spend the stamp on a calendar or the stamp is forgotten, so the annual prize must be given, and publishers time books to the eligibility window and lobby for a strong year to be split; the carrier is the calendar and the memory of the audience, the seller extracts the stamp's full value in a slow year at the price of a strong one, and the compulsion lapses the first time the gate withholds and survives, as the fiction Pulitzer did in 2012, which showed the must to be custom; speculative that the withholding then raises the stamp, since a stamp that can be withheld certifies more than one that cannot; not deal-flow-attractors' name others need, which decays by over-lending, since here the stamp decays by under-lending and the two decays meet at a rate the gate does not know.

residue.item: Buyer of last resort: the central bank's window, the pawnbroker, must buy whatever is offered at its price.
residue.why: Rejected: deal-flow-attractors' Counterparty of last resort already carries the always as a chosen attraction and prices its decay; the compelled version survives only as the designated market maker inside Tenure by consumption, where the always is a condition of the seat with an escape written in.

residue.item: Assigned risk: the insurer licensed in a state must take its share of the residual pool.
residue.why: Merged into Must-take by writ as a case; the mechanism is a higher gate spending the lower gate's money and it lapses by repeal, exactly as the silver purchases did.

residue.item: Farmhouse at the city rate: the utility must connect every customer under universal service.
residue.why: Rejected: a duty to serve at a loss, not a purchase from the passer; nothing is bought and no seller extracts. Kept as the boundary claim on duties to admit or serve.

residue.item: Quorum: the committee that cannot act without the marginal member must buy that member's attendance.
residue.why: Rejected: the pivotal member's leverage exists on any vote and belongs to coalition-frictions; only the version where the leverage exists solely on a bill that must pass survived, as Vehicle that must move.

residue.item: Gallery that must bid on its own artist at auction so the record does not print a low number.
residue.why: Rejected: already what-a-price-does' Price for the stranger's eyes; the compulsion there is on the record, not on the gate, and the gallery is not a chokepoint.

gate: declared modality, recognizable distinction, defensible seriation and conditional relations
limits: Authored conceptual fieldwork, not a taxonomy or a partition; a real gate usually carries several of these compulsions at once (a hospital is a licensed hour, a queue with an exit, and a borrowed eye), and the list claims no coverage.
The seriation is an itinerary of how a compulsion lapses, from repeal to a single survived refusal, and not a ranking of strength, cost, or frequency; map edges are conditional authored claims.

The illustrative cases (the 1893 silver repeal, PURPA contracts, the 2020 slot waiver, the 2013 shutdown, the 2012 Pulitzer, the diesel defeat device, verbatim findings) are simplified to expose one mechanism each and are not claims about the specific histories.

Ordinary purchases a gate makes because it needs things (paper, power, staff on a Tuesday) are out; only purchases compelled by the gate's position as gate are in, and duties to admit or serve without purchase (common carriage, universal service, the duty to treat) are out except where the duty forces a purchase, as in the manned hour.
Stamp with an expiry's claim that a survived withholding raises the stamp is speculative and marked so; the rest is analytical with observed cases.

gaps: The changed question yielded gates that must buy their own faculties from the parties they gate: sight (Borrowed eyes), the lean of a decision (No that must be written), the crowd that is the evidence (Papered house), the thing they stamp (Spec that must be brought), and their own successors (Celibate gate). The territory pointer 'tollgates that must buy' stands and the slug is kept; the of-sentence now names the clock-holder and the lapse rather than the structural/customary sort. The live question resolved into an itinerary of lapses (repeal, the escape written in, the passers' rerouting, the gate's own refusal), and at the customary end a survived refusal was found to strengthen the stamp rather than end the gate, which is kept as marked speculation and made the wild priority. Papered house split off from Shelf bought first when the two-sided gate was asked which side it must buy first, and the answer (the side whose absence the other side can see) became the fork edge.
accepted: No that must be written: when a gate's refusal requires a written reason and its acceptance requires none, the gate leans toward buying, so the applicant extracts the stamp by exhausting the writer, as patent continuations are refiled until an examiner's rejections cost more than an allowance, while at the consulate, where the refusal needs a sentence and the visa needs a file, the same asymmetry leans the other way; the carrier is the paperwork asymmetry, the seller extracts persistence priced in the examiner's hours, and the compulsion lapses when the gate's own reviewer starts counting bad yeses, as after a recalled drug; not the answer that may not be withheld, which forbids silence and leans neither way, since a jury must return and owes reasons for neither verdict.

Borrowed eyes: a gate that must decide on evidence it cannot make buys its sight from the party it is gating, as the drug regulator judges trials the sponsor designed and ran, the auditor relies on management's representations, and the rating agency rates from the issuer's numbers on the issuer's fee; the carrier is the missing witness architecture, the seller extracts the frame, the endpoints, the comparator, the definition of done, and the compulsion lapses only when someone builds the gate its own eyes, as a university laboratory rather than the regulator caught the diesel defeat device; not capture, which is a purchased gatekeeper, since this gate is honest and blind and buys what it must in order to see at all.

Papered house: when the crowd is the evidence, the gate buys the crowd, as the theatre gives away the first week's seats so critics see a full house and actors play to one, the conference comps the front rows, and the tuition-dependent college discounts the freshman class until the dormitory is full; the carrier is the reviewer who counts heads, the seller extracts a free seat or a merit scholarship whose merit is the calendar, since aid rises after the first of May, and the compulsion lapses when the reviews are in or the class is full; not shelf bought first, which buys supply so that buyers come, since here the gate buys buyers so that suppliers, critics, and other buyers come, and the two together form a fork over which side to buy.

Spec that must be brought: a standards body can adopt only what a member writes and must adopt something or lose the field to whoever standardizes without it, so the one member with running code sells the body its own product as the standard, as a vendor's implementation becomes the reference and its patents become essential; the carrier is the charter's deliverable together with the rule that the body writes nothing itself, the seller extracts the reference implementation and a royalty on every conforming device, and the compulsion lapses when a second complete proposal enters the room, which keeps the body's compulsion to adopt and destroys the seller's extraction, or when the market stops waiting for the body at all; not first-mover-forecloses' seizing of the standard, which is a race among rivals, since here the body's own emptiness is what is sold to.

Celibate gate: a gate that outlives its holders must buy every successor from outside, and the purer its rule against reproducing, the more completely it must buy, as the celibate church takes each generation of priests from families that owe it nothing, the partnership must make partners from its associates or die with its founders, and the dynasty without an heir must marry into a house that names its price in provinces; the carrier is mortality plus the succession rule, the seller extracts the successor's terms, the dowry, the partnership share, the package, and the compulsion never lapses but eases to the extent the gate can grow its own, which is why the vow that forbids growing one's own is the pure case; not status-conversions' inheritance, which is what passes to an heir, since here the question is what the gate must pay to have one.

residue.item: Captured regulator: the gate that has been bought by the party it gates.
residue.why: Rejected: a purchased gatekeeper runs the compulsion in the opposite direction; Borrowed eyes keeps the honest, blind gate, and its discriminator says so.

residue.item: Heir that must be got: the dynasty without a successor must marry into a house that names its price in provinces.
residue.why: Merged into Celibate gate as a case; the mechanism is mortality plus a succession rule, and the vow that forbids growing one's own successor turned out to be the pure form rather than the dynasty.

residue.item: Mint under free coinage: the mint must coin all silver brought to it at the fixed price.
residue.why: Merged into Must-take by writ as the silver purchase case once the breath found that the writ's repeal ran through the Treasury's own gold and so through Crown at the auction; that finding became an edge rather than an item.

residue.item: Ambulance that must go: the duty to treat whoever arrives at the emergency door.
residue.why: Rejected: a duty to admit without purchase; it enters the map only where the duty forces a purchase of staff, in Hour that must be manned.

residue.item: Commissioned rival: a standards body that manufactures a second proposal to destroy the sole author's extraction without losing its compulsion to adopt.
residue.why: Unresolved seed: as an item it is a move by the gate rather than a compulsion on it, so it is carried as the consequent of the Stamp with an expiry → Spec that must be brought edge; whether a gate can commission its own rival without the rival becoming a second sole author is the open question.

neighbors.left: Answer that may not be withheld: a court may not decline to decide a case properly before it, so the litigant who hands it the more adoptable answer sells the court its opinion, as trial judges sign proposed findings of fact verbatim and appellate opinions lift whole paragraphs from the winning brief; the carrier is the prohibition of non liquet together with the docket, the seller extracts the rule in its own words, and the compulsion lapses at the jurisdictional door, since dismissal for want of standing is the one way to answer without buying either story, and it thins toward the top, where a court that may deny review without reasons is under no compulsion at all; not persuasion-moves' shifting of a belief, since the court must take one of the two stories whether or not either persuades.

neighbors.separating_case: A petition for review at a court that may deny it without reasons, beside a patent application at an office where every rejection must be written: both gates are compelled to respond, the first leans no and the second leans yes. The answer that may not be withheld forbids silence and says nothing about direction; the no that must be written decides the direction. A jury shows the first without the second, since it must return and owes reasons for neither verdict, and so leans neither way.

checks.boundary_case: The sole cannery in the valley, which buys the whole tomato crop, is a gate that buys and is out: nothing compels it, the compulsion runs the other way, and the farmers must sell before the fruit rots (market-births' thick before it rots). The same cannery ordered by statute to take every tomato offered at a posted price is in, as Must-take by writ. What separates member from nonmember is not that the gate buys, nor how much, but that the gate's position as gate is what compels the purchase.
checks.form_inference: The map shows a fork the sequence conceals: Shelf bought first and Papered house sit as neighbors on the itinerary, but the edge between them says a two-sided gate must buy whichever side the other side reads as evidence, and a gate that buys the invisible side first has bought nothing. It shows a loop, Queue with an exit → Built to be bought → Queue with an exit, in which buying the bypass makes the queue captive, the compulsion to clear it lapses into rent, and the longer queue breeds the next bypass. It shows a passage between levels at Vehicle that must move → Hour that must be manned, where a calendar compulsion on the gate arrives at the sellers' level as a market in slots. And it shows two dependencies the line cannot express: Borrowed eyes → No that must be written, where a reasoned refusal must be written in the applicant's own evidence and the lean steepens, and Crown at the auction → Must-take by writ, where the writ at the head of the itinerary is repealed at the auction three items down, so the most structural compulsion lapses by way of a compulsion on its author.
checks.target_preserved: Self-read only. Each item names a distinct source of compulsion, a distinct clock-holder, a distinct extraction, and a distinct lapse; the strange members (a gate that must buy its own sight, a gate that must buy every successor because it may not breed one, a gate compelled by paperwork rather than by law, a stamp that decays by under-lending) are kept as mechanisms and not softened into advice about negotiating with monopolists.

next_crossfield_opening: Gates that must buy their own faculties: connect Borrowed eyes with witness-architectures' Silence priced as guilt (an arrangement that makes the accused build the instrument) and ask whether a gate that must buy its sight from the gated can ever price the gated's silence as guilt, or whether the two arrangements are the same purchase seen from the two ends of the gate.

gaps: The of-sentence and the boundary claim disagreed and the of-sentence lost: it said the gate buys from those who pass it, while Queue with an exit (the longshore union passes nothing), Hour that must be manned (the agency nurse is not the patient), Celibate gate (the families owe the church nothing), the airline case of Tenure by consumption, and Built to be bought (which buys from the one party that refuses to pass) all buy from suppliers of what the gate must have to remain a gate. Widened the of-sentence to the boundary claim's 'compelled by its position as gate'. Three item clauses asserted more than their cases support (a seller-less water right, central-bank purchase equated with inflation, a must-buy that omitted the gate's option to copy the bypass) and three edge labels carried cases that did not demonstrate their antecedent, most seriously Crown → Must-take, where the November 1893 repeal preceded the 1894 to 1895 bond sales and the gold drained at the redemption window rather than the auction.
accepted: Tenure by consumption: the gate keeps its gate only while it uses it, so it must buy a use, as the airline flies near-empty planes to keep a slot under the eighty-percent rule, the spectrum licensee builds out towers by the license's construction deadline or forfeits the band, and the designated market maker buys at its bid in a falling market because standing ready to buy is the condition of the seat; the carrier is the condition written into the tenure, the seller extracts by supplying the use, the codeshare partner and the discounted passenger, the tower contractor who reads the buildout date, the seller hitting the bid, and the compulsion lapses when the condition is waived, as slot rules were in 2020, or reaches the escape written into it, since the market maker's duty ends at the widest permitted quote and the trading halt; the western farmer who floods a field to keep a water right that lapses with non-use is the limit where the gate buys the use from no one and nothing is extracted, so it sits at the edge of the type rather than inside it; not deal-flow-attractors' counterparty of last resort, whose always is chosen and priced by the node, since here the always is rent on the seat and its ceiling is written by the landlord.

Crown at the auction: the sovereign that taxes and coins must still roll its debt on the day it matures, so the gate of money buys money from the dealers at whatever the auction says, as Charles V bought the imperial election with Fugger loans and the gilt market removed a British prime minister inside seven weeks; the carrier is the maturity calendar, which the sovereign wrote and cannot move, the seller extracts yield and, past yield, policy, and the compulsion lapses only into a primary surplus, which buys the money from the taxpayers instead, or into the central bank's purchase of the same paper, which moves the price from the dealers to the currency's holders and is paid in inflation when and only when they decide it is, so the escape is the borrower's own mint and that door is priced by a different crowd; not ordinary borrowing, since here the buyer of last resort and the borrower are one body with two names.

Papered house: when the crowd is the evidence, the gate buys the crowd, as the theatre gives away the first week's seats so critics see a full house and actors play to one, the conference comps the front rows, and the tuition-dependent college discounts the freshman class until the dormitory is full; the carrier is the reviewer who counts heads, the seller extracts a free seat or a merit scholarship whose merit is the calendar, since aid rises after the first of May, and the compulsion lapses when the reviews are in or the class is full; not shelf bought first, which buys supply so that buyers come, since here the gate buys buyers so that suppliers, critics, and other buyers come, and the two together form a fork over which side to buy; not what-a-price-does' price for the stranger's eyes, where the recorded number is the evidence and the gate buys the number, since here the bodies are the evidence and the price is spent down to zero to get them.

News hole: a gate with a fixed slot on a fixed clock must fill the slot whether or not anything arrived, so the seller who knows the slow day sells into the hole, as the press release runs on the Sunday the paper had nothing and the cable channel buys a panel to fill the hour; the carrier is the format, the seller extracts placement and the gate's editorial stamp at a price of zero, and the compulsion lapses when the slot becomes elastic, as the web page did, and returns wherever a fixed slot is reinstated, the daily show, the weekly newsletter, the quarterly call; not the shelf, which fills once, since the hole reopens on every tick; not the stamp with an expiry, which can print no award and leave the year empty, since the hole can only be substituted and never left empty, so a stamp whose format fixes the count, the forty under forty, is a hole wearing a stamp and decays by dilution rather than by under-lending.

Built to be bought: a gate whose franchise is worth more than any single bypass must buy each credible bypass it cannot copy, at the bypass's price, so a bypass is built to be sold to the gate it threatens, as the photo app with no revenue sold for a billion to the network it would have drained; the carrier is the franchise value and the gate's ability to see the bypass coming, the seller extracts a price set by the gate's loss rather than the bypass's earnings, and the compulsion lapses when the bypasses become a class too numerous to buy, when a higher gate forbids the purchase, or when the gate can copy the bypass faster than the bypass can grow, as the network copied the ephemeral story it had failed to buy, so the extraction is capped at the lesser of the gate's loss and the gate's cost to copy, and a bypass built to be sold must be one the gate cannot clone; not first-mover-forecloses' acquisition of a bottleneck, which is the mover's move, since here it is the gate's compulsion and the builder's plan.

residue.item: Clearinghouse default auction: the clearinghouse whose rulebook compels it to take over a defaulted member's book and sell it into an auction where the surviving members, who are the passers, bid knowing the gate must both buy and sell that day.
residue.why: Not admitted: the critic named it on the seam as a tempting member and did not propose it as a repair; it sits between compelled buying and compelled selling, and the repairer adds no items of its own. Carried in the seed with the mirror map.

residue.item: The critic's boundary case (essential facility under a duty to deal, FRAND licensing) as a replacement for the cannery.
residue.why: Not substituted: the critic did not show the cannery case fails; the duty-to-deal ruling was folded into the fourth limit instead, since what it teaches is a boundary (compelled purchase, not compelled dealing) rather than a better tempting nonmember.

limits: The seriation is an itinerary of how a compulsion lapses, from repeal to a single survived refusal, and not a ranking of strength, cost, or frequency; map edges are conditional authored claims. The Queue with an exit → Built to be bought loop is authored from the two items' text and has no observed case.

Ordinary purchases a gate makes because it needs things (paper, power, staff on a Tuesday) are out; only purchases compelled by the gate's position as gate are in, and duties to admit, serve, or deal without purchase (common carriage, universal service, the duty to treat, the essential facility's duty to carry a rival at a tariff, licensing on FRAND terms) are out except where the duty forces a purchase, as in the manned hour; compelled selling is the mirror map this one implies, tollgates that must sell.
seed: The un-poolable rival. The map's own seed is the body that commissions a second proposal to destroy its sole author's extraction without losing its compulsion to adopt; the 1995 disc merger shows the failure mode, two authors who pool and extract as one. The live question is what makes a commissioned rival un-poolable (a different licensing regime, a royalty-free charter, an author with nothing to cross-license), and whether the same construction works at every gate on the map that buys from a sole seller: a second agency for the night shift, a second sponsor-independent trial, a second dealer syndicate. Next to it sits the mirror map this one implies, tollgates that must sell, with the clearinghouse default auction as the case where a gate is compelled to buy and to sell to the same passers on the same day.
